name: program-runtime.portfolio-audit
purpose: Score declared programs against deterministic contract, evidence, usage, budget, learning, and output dimensions.

fixtures.note: The optional portfolio read must never turn unavailable measurement into a zero score.

signals.score: mean ratio across the eight deterministic dimensions
signals.scored: number of contracts included after min_rung and scenario filters
signals.worst: at most ten contracts with name, score, and gap labels
signals.budget_realism: count, total, and ratio when portfolio measurement is available
signals.exercised: count, total, and ratio when portfolio measurement is available

outputs.evidence: bounded typed library and portfolio reads

assumptions: The library response is the authoritative parsed contract index for this audit.
Portfolio rows measure the requested window and may be unavailable during a dependency outage.
A missing measurement is unknown and never a fabricated zero.
invariants: The envelope is printed exactly once, on every path.
No inference or delegated run is called.
Every score is derived from typed contract metadata or measured portfolio rows.
An unavailable portfolio read produces partial status and does not lower a dimension to zero.
